title: Lamb and Biryani Japanese-Style Kabobs
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with the classic Indian lamb and biryani dish, served as kabobs for a fun twist.
instructions: Cut lamb into bite-sized pieces and season with soy sauce, honey, and indian spices.
Thread lamb and kissed basmati rice onto skewers.
Grill kabobs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve with pillowy naan bread on the side.
Optional: garnish with additional indian spices and a sprinkle of soy sauce.
